title: A filter on one dimension reaches the fact table but not another dimension
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Customers", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Customer ), Product[Color] = "Blue" ) )

source.quote: a filter on Customer automatically filters Sales, whereas a filter on Sales propagates neither to Product nor to Customer or Date
source.supports: a filter reaches Sales from a dimension, and from Sales it propagates to no other dimension

derivation: Product[Color] = Blue filters Sales to rows 4 and 6 (customers 2 and 3). Sales[CustomerKey] -> Customer[CustomerKey] is single direction, so Customer is not filtered: 4 rows.
notes: With a both-direction relationship the answer would be 2; see crossfilter-both-in-calculate.
